subject: english
question:
The sentence given below has spelling errors. Select the sentence without spelling errors.

Knowledge and awareness about my own self has to preceede my knowledge of things other than me.

options.text: Knowledge and awareness about my own self has to preceede my knowledge of things other then me.
Knowledge and awareness about my own self has to precede my knowledge of things other than me.
Knowlegde and awareness about my own self has to preceede my knowlegde of things other than me.
Knowledge and awarenes about my own self has to preceede my knowledge of things other than me.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"precede"** means to come before something in time. (पहले आना)

 
 
• **Example: **A short speech will **precede** the presentation.
 
 
 
• **"other than" **refers to something different from or except for. (के अलावा)
 
 
• **Example: **She has no hobbies** other than** reading.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The word **"then"** is incorrect here; it should be "than" (से) to make a proper comparison.

 
 
• **Example:** She is taller than her brother.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** The word **"Knowlegde"** is a misspelling of "Knowledge" (ज्ञान).
 
 
• **Example:** Knowledge is power.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** The word **"awarenes"** is a misspelling of "awareness" (जागरूकता).
 
 
• **Example:** Awareness about health issues is crucial.
